title: Damped Atomic Wave Integration Neurons (DAWIN): A Universal Primitive for Continuous-Time Spatiotemporal Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30025v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional artificial neurons separate spatial feature aggregation from continuous physical time, limiting their ability to model irregular observations. We introduce the Damped Atomic Wave Integration Neuron (DAWIN), a continuous-time primitive for replacing standard neural layers in MLPs, Transformers, and graph neural networks. DAWIN couples spatial projection with elapsed-time-dependent wave excitation and integrates it into a local complex state through closed-form damped evolution, avoiding numerical differential equation solvers. We show that DAWIN generalizes static sinusoidal and memoryless wave neurons on interval-augmented inputs, derive closed-form gradients, and establish bounded-input bounded-output stability for positive damping and sampling intervals bounded away from zero. An associative Triton prefix-scan implementation, DAWINLinear, uses FP32 accumulation and achieves O(log L) parallel depth for sequence length L. Ac

translated_title: 阻尼原子波积分神经元（DAWIN）：连续时间时空学习的通用基元
translated_abstract: 传统人工神经元将空间特征聚合与连续物理时间相分离，限制了其建模不规则观测数据的能力。我们提出了阻尼原子波积分神经元（DAWIN），这是一种连续时间基元，可用于替代MLP、Transformer和图神经网络中的标准神经层。DAWIN将空间投影与依赖于经过时间的波激励相耦合，并通过闭式阻尼演化将其积分到局部复数状态中，从而避免了使用数值微分方程求解器。我们证明DAWIN在区间增强输入上推广了静态正弦波神经元和无记忆波神经元，推导出了闭式梯度，并在正阻尼和采样区间远离零的条件下建立了有界输入有界输出（BIBO）稳定性。我们提出了基于结合律的Triton前缀扫描实现DAWINLinear，使用FP32累加，对长度为L的序列实现了O(log L)的并行深度。
tldr: 本文提出了一种连续时间神经元基元DAWIN，通过闭式阻尼波演化将物理时间融入神经网络状态，可替代MLP、Transformer和图神经网络中的标准神经层，兼具闭式梯度、BIBO稳定性保证和O(log L)并行深度的计算效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DAWIN, a continuous-time neuron primitive that integrates physical time into neural network states via closed-form damped wave evolution, replacing standard layers in MLPs, Transformers, and GNNs with closed-form gradients, BIBO stability guarantees, and O(log L) parallel-depth efficiency.
